positional_8.name: Positional
positional_8.description: Each name's position ID is copied onto its bound entity; the recalled name's position ID retrieves it.
positional_8.template: Ann loves ale, Joe loves jam, Pete loves pie, Tim loves tea. What does Tim love?

lexical_8.name: Lexical
lexical_8.description: Each entity is bound to its name; the recalled name itself retrieves the bound entity.
lexical_8.template: Ann loves ale, Joe loves jam, Pete loves pie, Tim loves tea. What does Tim love?

reflexive_8.name: Reflexive
reflexive_8.description: The query retrieves a pointer to the answer entity itself, which is dereferenced at the end. Fails if the entity isn't in context.
reflexive_8.template: Ann loves ale, Joe loves jam, Pete loves pie, Tim loves tea. What does Tim love?

mixed_8.name: Mixed
mixed_8.description: The union of the three algorithms: each computes its own answer, and the last token combines them linearly into a distribution over the entities.
mixed_8.template: Ann loves ale, Joe loves jam, Pete loves pie, Tim loves tea. What does Tim love?
